title: Databricks Access Policy
content: Employees must request workspace access through the IT service desk. Access must be approved by the relevant manager and follow least-privilege principles. Production access requires additional authorization.

title: Incident Management Policy
content: High-priority incidents must be triaged promptly. The assigned support team must record investigation steps, communicate material status changes, and close an incident only after resolution is verified.

title: Customer Data Handling Policy
content: Customer information must be accessed only for authorized business purposes. Sensitive data must not be disclosed to unauthorized users or included in unapproved external services.
